about: Show vocabulary allowed in core files (tests/test_core_has_no_show_vocabulary.py). path: a file or a glob; pattern: a regex found in the allowed line (in the path, for a file name); reason: why the words stay; remove_by: the date by which the entry is gone or renewed with a new reason.

entries.reason: The compatibility layer: the legacy adapter (the first series as a show profile) and the shims that keep its recorded episodes, stored headcount rows and older importers working. The only place in the engine where that series' words may stay; see docs/SHOW-PROFILE.md.
Deprecated module name: a three-line re-export of hfvg.compat.species_counter that warns, kept one release for older importers.
Optional archetype catalogue of the create wizard: the cards tagged catalogue "animal-pack" are about non-human characters by design. Allowed by path, not by word.
The web mirror of hfvg/data/genre_presets.yaml (tests/test_preset_sync.py), same catalogue cards. Allowed by path, not by word.
Gait verbs the motion check recognises in any shot's motion text (a waddling walk is a walk). A word list, not a show rule; changing it would change the motion QC of recorded episodes.
Object-contact word of the motion check (a limb that handles an object), next to hand and mouth. A word list, not a show rule; changing it would change the motion QC of recorded episodes.

Workflow code pinned by replay (parked runs): the recompose validator keeps accepting the first series' flag-figure key that running workflows and the legacy adapter use. A show's own shot flags travel under "flags".
